# CYCLE DIPLOMATY *by DiploCité*

## Editorial

Founded in 2023 at the *Cité internationale universitaire de Paris*^[More about CiuP: [https://www.ciup.fr](https://www.ciup.fr)], *DiploCité*^[More about DiploCité: [https://linktr.ee/diplocite](https://linktr.ee/diplocite)] is an initiative and editorial platform dedicated to international relations, diplomacy, and global affairs.

Our community brings together students and alumni of the Cité internationale universitaire de Paris, members of DiploCité, and experts of all nationalities and disciplines who share a passion for understanding the world. We also welcome invited contributors: researchers, practitioners, and voices from the field who enrich our pages with first-hand experience and diverse perspectives.

We publish rigorous yet accessible analyses on diplomacy, geopolitics, multilateralism, and cultural relations, guided by a commitment to intellectual diversity and editorial independence.

_All contributions reflect the views of their authors alone and do not engage the responsibility of DiploCité or the Cité internationale universitaire de Paris._
